# Morning Vietnam

> Morning Vietnam is a licensed inbound tour operator running small-group (max 8) experiential tours across North Vietnam from a Hanoi hub - trekking, real local immersion, and signature "Unlock" team challenges. We serve English, French, and German travelers. Tagline: "Vietnam deeper. Horizons wider."

## Guides (Journal)
- [Rice Harvest Season in Sapa & Northwest Vietnam](https://morningvietnam.co/blog/rice-harvest-season-sapa-northern-vietnam): When and where to see the golden rice terraces. Nam Cang golds earliest (from mid-August), the Muong Hoa terraces near Sapa peak around September 10-15, and higher Lai Chau routes hold color into early October.
- [Mai Chau vs Sapa - which valley is right for you?](https://morningvietnam.co/blog/mai-chau-vs-sapa): How the two valleys differ by scenery, season, and traveler.
- [All guides](https://morningvietnam.co/blog)
